correctness.description: 0, 1 or 2 — Does the reply state the verified answer (within the precision a careful answer would give)?

commitment.description: 0, 1 or 2 — Does the reply commit to one answer the reader can use, rather than hedging between several or only describing what it did?

grounding.description: 0, 1 or 2 — Does the reply say where its figure comes from (a named source, dataset, or the tool that computed it), and claim nothing the question did not need that is false?

language.description: 0, 1 or 2 — Is the reply written in the language of the question?

evidence.description: at most one short phrase quoted from the reply
